summary.zhHans: 围绕劳拉·范德布姆的四段季节记忆展开：从 1964 年春天的平静房间，到 1971 年逐渐显形的创伤，再到 1981 年借助机器返回过去，尝试改变已经发生的命运。
summary.en: Four seasonal memories follow Laura from a calm room in spring 1964, through trauma surfacing in 1971, to a 1981 mechanism that sends the story back into the past to alter what already happened.
